from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
app = FastAPI()

class UserOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str

@app.get("/users/{uid}", response_model=UserOut)
def get_user(uid: int):
    return UserOut(id=uid, name="x")
